content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Montgomery

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific eligibility criteria to verify you meet the required hours in both categories. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you assess your background and confirm readiness before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. This formal education satisfies PMI's required contact hours and covers the PMBOK Guide, real-world case studies, and exam domains. Attend all sessions to earn your certificate of completion.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the boot camp, submit your PMI application online and pay the associated examination fee. Your Granite PM Academy certificate of completion will support your application. PMI will review and approve your eligibility before you can schedule the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides targeted exam-preparation resources to reinforce key content. Schedule your proctored PMP exam once PMI approves your application. You may test at an authorized Pearson VUE center or via remote proctoring at your convenience.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP credential is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteering, or authoring. Renew your credential on schedule to keep your competitive edge in Montgomery's growing project-management field.
